summary.text: Angela Humphries is the Libertarian candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 3 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Steve Tyson (R) and Democrat Diannia Bright.

paragraphs.text: In a Ballotpedia survey, Angela Humphries said her campaign messages include allowing families to opt out of public schools without paying twice for education, adopting permitless carry, and reducing regulations such as Certificate of Need laws in health care.

She said she is also concerned about protecting life, government transparency and lessening local, state and federal burdens on residents, and she noted the endorsement of the Libertarian Party of North Carolina.

sources.title: Angela Humphries's Ballotpedia Candidate Connection survey (2026)
